change.title: Move downgrade Science wait outside AppState with owner CAS
change.summary: Extends the process-local Science stop owner boundary to terminal Codex downgrade cleanup. The operation keeps its generation bump and stop-all policy, but claims the exact Science owner under AppState, executes the existing stop policy without AppState, and publishes only after generation and complete owner CAS. A stale result preserves replacement Science ownership, still stops the tracked Gateway under the existing terminal policy, and fails before export, backup, or v2 publication.

basis: downgrade cleanup reuses the existing process-local Science owner claim, lock-free execution, and generation plus complete identity CAS publication helper
the deterministic regression separately exercises generation-only and identity-only drift and proves AppState remains readable during the Science stop wait
stale publication preserves replacement Science ownership, retains the existing terminal policy of stopping the tracked Gateway, and returns before downgrade export or config effects
existing downgrade characterizations continue to freeze safe precommit, committed export, uncertain v2 publication, direct terminal exit, and no-restart semantics
transaction-scoped one-click, history, recovery, and compensation stop boundaries remain outside this bounded slice
